novruz.name: Novruz
novruz.note: Illustrative annual late-March overlay, not a confirmed event or railway calendar. Confirm dates.

hotels.name: Qala Courtyard House
hotels.description: Fictional courtyard guesthouse inside the real Old City. Cobbled streets can make luggage and step-free access difficult.

hotels.name: Caspian Promenade Hotel
hotels.description: Fictional waterfront hotel in the Sahil area, convenient for the Boulevard.

hotels.name: Nizami Street Suites
hotels.description: Fictional suites by the pedestrian shopping streets. Sahil is the nearest seeded metro station, computed from coordinates.

hotels.name: Flame Hill Residence
hotels.description: Fictional hilltop residence. The metro distance is straight-line, not an accessible walking route; allow for the steep hill or a taxi.

hotels.name: Station Square Inn
hotels.description: Fictional inn near the 28 May interchange, railway station and H1 terminus.

hotels.name: White City Lofts
hotels.description: Fictional apartments in White City, east of Port Baku. Khatai, not Koroglu or Ganjlik, is nearest in the approximate station dataset.

hotels.name: Absheron Shore Resort
hotels.description: Fictional coastal resort at Mardakan, not central Baku. No practical walk to the metro: use a direct airport transfer and budget road journeys to the city.

hotels.name: Silk Caravan Guesthouse
hotels.description: Fictional guesthouse near Sheki's historic centre. The station is outside town; any announced sleeper timetable must be reconfirmed.

hotels.name: Tufandag Valley Lodge
hotels.description: Fictional mountain lodge near the Tufandag valley. Gabala railway station requires an onward road transfer.

hotels.name: Qudyalchay River Rooms
hotels.description: Fictional rooms beside Guba's river corridor. Mountain excursions need road transport and a local conditions check.

hotels.name: Shahdag Snowline Chalet
hotels.description: Fictional mountain chalet. The demo permits skiing only December–March; actual snow, lift operation and road conditions are not verified.

hotels.name: Javad Khan Street Hotel
hotels.description: Fictional central Ganja hotel. Daily Baku rail is a baseline service pattern, not a booked connection.

activities.name: Guided walk of Icherisheher (UNESCO Old City)
activities.description: Real UNESCO-listed Old City; fictional guided slot and per-person price.
activities.how_to_get_there: Icheri Sheher metro, then walk. Allow extra time on cobbled streets.

activities.name: Maiden Tower and roof deck
activities.description: Real Old City landmark with stairs; synthetic admission slot, capacity and price.
activities.how_to_get_there: Walk from Icheri Sheher metro through the Old City.

activities.name: Palace of the Shirvanshahs
activities.description: Real palace complex, including outdoor courtyards. Synthetic visit window and admission estimate.
activities.how_to_get_there: Icheri Sheher metro and an uphill walk through the Old City.

activities.name: Heydar Aliyev Center (Zaha Hadid)
activities.description: Real cultural centre; fictional slot, opening window and price. Indoor alternative for seasonally windy months, not a live weather recommendation.
activities.how_to_get_there: Nariman Narimanov metro and an approximately 20-minute walk, or a short road transfer.

activities.name: Azerbaijan Carpet Museum
activities.description: Real museum on the Boulevard; synthetic slot, opening window and admission price.
activities.how_to_get_there: Icheri Sheher metro, then approximately 15 minutes on foot towards the Boulevard.

activities.name: Funicular, Martyrs' Lane viewpoint and Flame Towers lights
activities.description: Real memorial and viewpoint; visit respectfully. The synthetic evening window does not guarantee sunset, funicular operation or a light-show schedule.
activities.how_to_get_there: Walk towards the funicular from Icheri Sheher; a road transfer avoids the steep climb.

activities.name: Baku Boulevard and Caspian boat trip
activities.description: Real waterfront; fictional combined walk and boat slot. Operation depends on conditions and is never guaranteed.
activities.how_to_get_there: Sahil metro, then walk towards the waterfront.

activities.name: Gobustan rock carvings and mud volcanoes
activities.description: Real sites south-west of Baku. The synthetic five-hour experience includes travel between the carvings and mud-volcano area, but not travel from Baku; avoid muddy access after heavy rain.
activities.how_to_get_there: Road transfer only; allow approximately 75 minutes each way from central Baku.

activities.name: Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanar Dag
activities.description: Two real Absheron landmarks. Synthetic four-hour visit includes the road journey between them; outbound and return city transfers are additional.
activities.how_to_get_there: Road transfer on the Absheron Peninsula; approximately 60 minutes from central Baku before the experience.

activities.name: Food tour: plov, qutab, dolma and tea
activities.description: Real Azerbaijani food traditions around Fountains Square; fictional hosted tasting, venues and price. Ask any real provider about allergens.
activities.how_to_get_there: Walk from Sahil metro to the Fountains Square area.

activities.name: Sheki Khan's Palace and caravanserai day
activities.description: Real historic Sheki landmarks; synthetic seven-hour experience including local transfers. A Baku return journey plus this full day is too long: choose a Sheki hotel or arrange a separate overnight stay.
activities.how_to_get_there: Stay locally. Baku is approximately five hours away by road; the announced post-20-November-2026 night train has no confirmed timetable in this dataset.

activities.name: Gabala cable car and Nohur Lake
activities.description: Real Tufandag and Nohur Lake locations. Synthetic six-hour experience includes local transfers; cable cars and mountain roads require a conditions check.
activities.how_to_get_there: Weekend or explicitly confirmed holiday rail to Gabala, then road transfer; otherwise approximately four hours by road from Baku.

activities.name: Guba, Candy Cane Mountains and Khinalig village
activities.description: Real Guba-region and northern road-corridor sights. Synthetic nine-hour excursion includes substantial local driving; from Baku it is a very long day. Mountain access is not live-verified.
activities.how_to_get_there: Road only. The experience starts in Guba and includes the regional loop; a Guba hotel avoids the additional Baku return journey.

activities.name: Shahdag ski day
activities.description: Real Shahdag mountain area; fictional six-hour ski slot and price. December–March only in the demo, subject to actual snow, lift operation and insurance.
activities.how_to_get_there: Road transfer only, approximately 3.5 hours each way from central Baku; staying in Shahdag is less tiring.

activities.name: Shamakhi wine tasting
activities.description: Real Shamakhi wine-growing region with a fictional adult-only tasting and operator. Use a driver; the synthetic half-day duration excludes Baku transfers.
activities.how_to_get_there: Road transfer, approximately two hours each way from Baku. No rail route is assumed.
